messages.subject: Error with unmarked::formatWide()
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have been working with 6 observation-level covariates and 8 site-level covariates and I keep getting this error when I run this:

occ_um <- formatWide(occ_wide, type = "unmarkedFrameOccu")

Error in formatWide(occ_wide, type = "unmarkedFrameOccu") : 
  Not all observation-level covariates have the same number of columns.

I have been racking my head over where I could be going wrong, but I seem to have the right number of observation level columns  (4 visits to a site, so 4 columns for each observation level covariate). 

Any assistance would be much appreciated.

Vijay

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: Error with unmarked::formatWide()
parts:
Thanks for replying Alex!

I was able to solve this issue, by looking at the R documentation for unmarked::formatWide()

The documentation mentions: 

The column order for formatWide is
(optional) site name, named “site”.
response, named “y.1”, “y.2”, …, “y.J”.
columns of site-level covariates, each with a relevant name per column.
groups of columns of observation-level covariates, each group having the name form “someObsCov.1”, “someObsCov.2”, …, “someObsCov.J”.

I re-coded each of my site-level covariates as: land.cover.y, climate.y, elevation.y and it seems to be able to differentiate between site-level and observation-level covariates. Weird fix, but it works!

Vijay
